name: 2D Opacity Functions for Soft Isosurfaces
definition: The use of two-dimensional opacity functions to create soft isosurfaces, serving as a base component for visualizing bones in mouse embryos where CT values are indistinguishable from soft tissue.
summary: This method renders soft isosurfaces by mapping voxel opacity using two scalar inputs, enabling visualization of structures like bones in mouse embryos where CT values are indistinguishable from soft tissue.
